description: This file defines dependencies and utility functions related to user authentication and authorization within a FastAPI backend, including token validation and role-based access control.

classes.name: CurrentUser
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing the current authenticated user, including id, role, email, and activity status.

methods.name: CurrentUser _load_user(session: AsyncSession, user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Asynchronous function that retrieves user details from the database based on user ID, raising exceptions if user not found or inactive.

methods.name: CurrentUser get_current_user( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(bearer_scheme), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency that extracts and validates the user from a bearer token in the request, returning CurrentUser instance.

methods.name: CurrentUser require_admin(user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Dependency that ensures the current user has the admin role; raises an exception if not.

methods.name: CurrentUser require_driver_or_admin(user: CurrentUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Dependency that ensures the current user has either driver or admin role; raises an exception if not.

ctags.name: get_current_user
ctags.signature: ( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(bearer_scheme), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
